title.narrative: Supporting Sudanese kidney failure patients affected by the conflict in Egypt

description.narrative: Overall Project Objective: 1. Performing 100,000 dialysis procedures. 2. Providing medications for dialysis patients. 3. Providing medications for kidney transplant patients. 4. Conducting medical examinations for kidney failure and kidney transplant patients.

Performing more than 100,000 dialysis procedures for Sudanese kidney failure patients residing in Egypt, in addition to conducting the necessary medical examinations. The project also includes providing life-saving medications for patients undergoing kidney transplants and conducting the necessary medical examinations to monitor their health.
Saving the lives of dialysis and kidney transplant patients.
